sentences.en: We cannot separate the sheep from the goats by appearance.
sentences.zh: 我们不能仅凭外表就把绵羊和山羊区分开来。

sentences.en: Mrs. Jones counts sheep every night to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 琼斯太太每晚数绵羊才能入睡。

sentences.en: As well be hanged for a sheep as a lamb.

senses.zh: 绵羊；羊；绵羊（复数形式与单数形式相同）；温顺的人；盲从的人
